paper_metadata.title: Enhancement of strength-ductility trade-off in Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 high entropy alloy through annealing twins

evidence.quote: Here, we designed a single FCC phase Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 HEA with low stacking fault energy
Partially recrystallized and fully recrystallized Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 HEA with excellent tensile mechanical properties were prepared by a simple cold rolling and short annealing process.
The as-cast sheet was homogenized at 1250 ◦C for 2 h, water-quenched (referred to as AC).

Al5Fe25Cr25Ni42.5Ti2.5 HEAs were prepared by vacuum arc melting. Each ingot was turned over and remelted five times to ensure chemical uniformity, and then dropped onto a slab-shaped copper mold with a size of 10 × 6 × 60 mm3.
The as-cast sheet was homogenized at 1250 ◦C for 2 h, water-quenched (referred to as AC).
Then cold-rolled at room temperature to a thickness reduction of 75 %.
